title: A Vector for the Protocol
author: M. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Elodie Crane, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
